title: Choose the look of bhccob.me
question: Four complete directions for your portfolio. Open each one with the expand chip to try the live prototype, then lock the one you want built.

options.label: Departures
options.lineage: Split-flap departure boards at Rotterdam Centraal and Aruba's airport
options.thesis: Your portfolio as a departures board: one route from Aruba to Rotterdam, where projects depart and future roles are scheduled.
options.viewport: A full-width board: BOB CHUNG built from yellow flap tiles, then live rows for Project #01, #02 and the next build, with Rotterdam and Aruba clocks.
options.risk: Split-flap is a known novelty; it must lead the hero and the project index only, with quieter sections below, or it tires.

raised.raise: Every status is a word and a mark (DEPARTED, BOARDING, SCHEDULED, HELD), and unlisted projects stay visible on a quiet HELD AT GATE line.
The board's ambient light follows the real time in Rotterdam, in named phases from night shift to daylight.
The blueprint mounting grid is drawn live and bends toward the cursor instead of being a static image.
The board remembers a returning visitor and flips a welcome-back line.

options.label: The Board
options.lineage: Hobbyist purple circuit boards with gold (ENIG) pads
options.thesis: The site is a purple circuit board with gold pads: you are the main chip, and every section is a component wired to it.
options.viewport: A chip labelled U1 BOB CHUNG at the centre; gold traces run from its pins to edge connectors that are the navigation, and the cursor sends a signal pulse along the nearest trace.
options.risk: Circuit boards are the obvious tech picture; this works only if the traces really are the navigation and the labels stay plain.

options.label: Woven Code
options.lineage: Jacquard looms: punched cards, the ancestor of programming, weaving silk brocade
options.thesis: Punched binary rows weave your name in gold across midnight-purple silk: the first programmable machine meeting the firmware you want to write.
options.viewport: A loom across the screen: moving the cursor throws the shuttle, the punch rows above scroll, and BOB CHUNG resolves out of the woven matrix.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: punched cards lead to programming and silk brocade nods to your Chinese heritage; loses narrowly on instant clarity for recruiters.
options.risk: Can read as fashion or craft rather than engineering if the binary layer is not legible.

options.label: Four-Language Print
options.lineage: Two-ink screen-printed posters with a multilingual typographic border
options.thesis: A two-ink screen print: your portrait as one flat emblem, framed by your line in English, Dutch, Papiamento and Chinese.
options.viewport: Halftone portrait centred on a purple sheet, the four-language border running around all edges, each ink layer pulled across the screen like a squeegee.
options.case: Fuses well on identity: the multilingual border is unmistakably you; loses on clarity because the work only appears after scrolling.
options.risk: The Papiamento and Chinese lines need your approval, and a poster can feel static once the print animation ends.

options.label: Cutting Bench
options.lineage: Film editors' work prints strung on a select rail
options.thesis: Projects as film frames on a perforated rail, with trims hanging on pins below.
options.viewport: A perforated rail across the screen holding each project as a frame.
options.case: Fuses poorly: nothing in your story is film editing, and the rail is harder to read than a list.
options.kept: Status shown as a mark, not just a colour, and set-aside work kept visible.
options.risk: Borrowed world with no link to you.

options.label: Mini Room
options.thesis: An isometric room as your profile, furnished with plates, a paddle and a controller.
options.viewport: A pastel isometric room with a visitor counter.
options.case: Fuses poorly: too playful for employers and teachers, and it hides the projects.

options.label: Horizon Grid
options.thesis: A wireframe grid racing toward a banded sun.
options.viewport: Extruded name above a moving perspective grid.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a familiar costume rather than your story, and everything is forced onto one centre line.
options.kept: A grid rendered live that reacts to the cursor.

options.label: Dawn Stage
options.thesis: Scrolling raises the lights from night to day.
options.viewport: A black stage with a cobalt band rising.
options.case: Fuses poorly: theatre has no tie to you and its colours fight purple and yellow.
options.kept: Atmosphere tied to real time, in named phases.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark developer portfolio done well: big name, short intro, project cards, contact.
canonCard.viewport: Large name and role on the left, a portrait on the right, project cards below.
canonCard.risk: Looks like many other student portfolios by design.
